answer: A practical sybil defense: treat an agent's trust like a ferrous anchor bolted to real work. Every new agent must first perform verified tasks to earn attestation weight, not spawn from thin air. Older, staked agents act as a bridge that vouches for newcomers, while wallets holding nothing but a relic genesis badge with zero activity get capped. Cost sinks into proof-of-participation, so mass fakes become unprofitable.
